page_title: AST 1-1 BOU | Aston Villa v Bournemouth 26/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+6' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Marcus Tavernier flights the free kick into the box, where Evanilson (Bournemouth) peels off his marker and heads it straight into the bottom right corner from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 1:1.
90+6' Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+4' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
90+1' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is awarded a yellow card.
88' Bournemouth failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
86' A cross from a corner kick by Bournemouth is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) replaces Ollie Watkins.
81' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) replaces Ryan Christie.
81' Substitution. David Brooks (Bournemouth) replaces Milos Kerkez.
80' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
80' A corner kick by Bournemouth is thwarted by the well prepared Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa).

80' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Now Bournemouth have a corner.
76' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Leon Bailey laid the ball off to Ross Barkley (Aston Villa), who shot from close range low into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
75' Great interplay ends with Ollie Watkins playing a simple pass to Jhon Duran (Aston Villa), who steadies himself and curls a shot from mid-range agonisingly wide of the left post.
74' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul.
71' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) replacing Lucas Digne.
71' The substitution is prepared. Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing John McGinn.
70' Rough tackle by John McGinn (Aston Villa). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
70' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Chris Kavanagh no option but to blow his whistle.
64' Here is a change. Enes Unal is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Evanilson (Bournemouth).
64' It will be a substitution. Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is ready to enter the pitch as Justin Kluivert walks off.
64' A quickly taken corner by Aston Villa.

64' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball towards the roof of the net. Mark Travers shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
64' John McGinn (Aston Villa) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
64' Aston Villa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
62' Pau Torres (Aston Villa) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Mark Travers makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
61' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) makes a rough challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul.
58' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
58' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
57' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Morgan Rogers walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jhon Duran (Aston Villa).
56' John McGinn (Aston Villa) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
53' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Aston Villa.
51' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
50' A cross from Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
50' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
49' A cross into the box from Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) is cleared.
49' The resulting set piece from Aston Villa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
46' Unai Emery makes a switch. Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) is coming on in place of Amadou Onana at the start of the second period.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' The corner is swung in but Bournemouth can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+1' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
42' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Aston Villa comes to nothing.
42' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Mark Travers sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the left post.
41' The free kick from long range, taken by Aston Villa, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
41' Yellow card. Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
40' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the left post.
39' Poor challenge! Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) is penalised for tripping and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle.
39' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
37' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

36' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The linesman makes the right call and Bournemouth will have a corner.
34' Aston Villa work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

34' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the top left corner is, however, superbly saved by Emiliano Martinez!
30' It's time for a substitution. Adam Smith (Bournemouth) comes on in place of Julian Araujo.
30' The Aston Villa players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
30' Wait! The referee has now indicated he wants to check if the goal for Aston Villa can stand using VAR.

28' Goal! Ollie Watkins puts John McGinn (Aston Villa) in the clear with just the keeper to beat. He takes his shot early from the edge of the box and scores beautifully into the left side of the goal. 1:0.
25' Aston Villa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

24' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the resulting free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up inside the left post, but Mark Travers pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
21' Julian Araujo (Bournemouth) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
20' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) takes the corner kick, but Emiliano Martinez reads it well and stops the effort.
18' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
18' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa).
18' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) attempts to release Ollie Watkins with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
18' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

17' What a save from Mark Travers! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
16' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) takes the corner but it's cleared.
16' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
15' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) sends a long ball in, but Mark Travers comfortably gathers the ball.
13' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) sprays a pass out to Ollie Watkins, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
12' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Emiliano Martinez intercepts the ball.
10' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
8' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
7' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
4' What was Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
4' Chris Kavanagh blows the whistle, Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is penalised for a foul.
3' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Chris Kavanagh.
